sentences.zh: 秦良玉龍在田馬世龍，字蒼元，寧夏人。

translations.literal: Qin Liangyu; Long Zaitian. Ma Shilong, styled Cangyuan, was a native of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Liangyu; Long Zaitian. Ma Shilong, styled Cangyuan, was a native of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 由世職舉武會試，歷宣府遊擊。

translations.literal: By hereditary office he passed the military metropolitan examination and served in succession as mobile commander at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Through his hereditary post he passed the military metropolitan examination and rose to serve as mobile commander at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年擢永平副總兵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi he was promoted to deputy regional commander at Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianqi reign he was promoted to deputy regional commander at Yongping.

sentences.zh: 署兵部孫承宗奇其才，薦授署都督僉事，充三屯營總兵官。

translations.literal: Sun Chengzong of the Ministry of War, acting in office, admired his talent, recommended him for appointment as acting Commissioner-in-chief, and installed him as overall commander of the Santunying garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chengzong of the Ministry of War, then serving in an acting capacity, took notice of his ability, recommended him for appointment as acting Commissioner-in-chief, and made him overall commander of the Santunying garrison.

sentences.zh: 承宗出鎮，薦為山海總兵，俾領中部，調總兵王世欽、尤世祿分領南北二部。

translations.literal: When Chengzong went out to command the frontier, he recommended him as overall commander at Shanhai, had him lead the central sector, and transferred the overall commanders Wang Shiqin and You Shilu to command the southern and northern sectors respectively.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong took command on the frontier, he recommended Shilong as overall commander at Shanhai, put him in charge of the central sector, and reassigned the overall commanders Wang Shiqin and You Shilu to lead the southern and northern sectors.

sentences.zh: 明年正月賜尚方劍，實授府銜。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year he was granted the imperial sword and received substantive commission to the commandery rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year he was granted the imperial sword of authority and received substantive appointment to commandery rank.

sentences.zh: 承宗為築壇拜大將，代行授鉞禮，軍馬錢谷盡屬之。

translations.literal: Chengzong built an altar and invested him as grand general, performing the ceremony of bestowing the ceremonial axe in his stead; troops, horses, funds, and grain all came under his authority.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong built an altar, invested him as grand general, and performed the ceremony of bestowing the ceremonial axe on his behalf; troops, horses, funds, and grain all passed into his hands.

sentences.zh: 尋定分地，世龍居中，駐衛城，世欽南海，世祿北山，並受世龍節制，兵各萬五千人。

translations.literal: Soon afterward domains were allotted: Shilong held the center and was stationed at Weicheng; Shiqin held the southern sea and Shilu the northern mountains; both were subject to Shilong's command, each with fifteen thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Before long their sectors were fixed: Shilong held the center and was stationed at Weicheng, Shiqin at the southern sea, and Shilu at the northern mountains; both were placed under Shilong's command, each with fifteen thousand men.

sentences.zh: 世龍感承宗知已，頗盡力，與承宗定計出守關外諸城。

translations.literal: Shilong, grateful for Chengzong's trust, exerted himself considerably and, together with Chengzong, worked out a plan to sally forth and hold the cities beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Grateful for Chengzong's confidence in him, Shilong applied himself with real effort and, together with Chengzong, devised a plan to march out and hold the cities beyond the pass.

sentences.zh: 四年，偕巡撫喻安性及袁崇煥東巡廣寧，又與崇煥、世欽航海抵蓋套，相度形勢而還。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, together with Grand Coordinator Yu Anxing and Yuan Chonghuan he made an eastern inspection tour of Guangning; he also sailed with Chonghuan and Shiqin to Gaotao, surveyed the terrain, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he joined Grand Coordinator Yu Anxing and Yuan Chonghuan on an eastern inspection of Guangning, and later sailed with Chonghuan and Shiqin to Gaotao, surveyed the terrain, and returned.

sentences.zh: 敘勞，加右都督。

translations.literal: In recognition of his service he was promoted to Right Commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: His service was recorded and he was promoted to Right Commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 當是時，承宗統士馬十余萬，用將校數百人，歲費軍儲數百萬。

translations.literal: At that time Chengzong commanded more than a hundred thousand men and horses, employed several hundred officers, and spent several million in military stores each year.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chengzong commanded more than a hundred thousand troops, employed several hundred officers, and spent several million taels in military stores every year.

sentences.zh: 諸有求於承宗者，率因世龍，不得則大恚。

translations.literal: Those who sought favors from Chengzong mostly went through Shilong; if they failed to obtain them they were greatly enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Those who sought favors from Chengzong usually had to go through Shilong, and if they failed they were furious.

sentences.zh: 而世龍貌偉，中實怯，忌承宗者多擊世龍以撼之。

translations.literal: Yet Shilong looked imposing but was inwardly timid; many who resented Chengzong attacked Shilong in order to shake him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Shilong cut an imposing figure while being timid at heart, and many of Chengzong's enemies struck at Shilong in order to shake him.

sentences.zh: 承宗抗辯於朝曰：「人謂其貪淫朘削，臣敢以百口保其必無。

translations.literal: Chengzong argued in court, saying: "People say he is greedy, lecherous, and skims and squeezes—I dare stake a hundred mouths on their certainly not being so."
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong argued before the court: "People call him greedy, lecherous, and given to skimming and squeezing—I will stake a hundred lives on the certainty that he is not."

sentences.zh: 」帝以承宗故，不問。

translations.literal: " Because of Chengzong the Emperor did not pursue the matter.
translations.idiomatic: " Because of Chengzong, the Emperor let the matter drop.

sentences.zh: 五年九月，世龍誤信降人劉伯漒言、遣前鋒副將魯之甲、參將李承先率師襲取耀州，敗沒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year, Shilong mistakenly trusted the word of the surrendering tribesman Liu Boluan and sent the vanguard deputy commander Lu Zhijia and the assistant commander Li Chengxian at the head of a force to strike and seize Yaozhou; they were defeated and wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifth year Shilong mistakenly believed the surrendering tribesman Liu Boluan and sent the vanguard deputy commander Lu Zhijia and the assistant commander Li Chengxian to lead a force in a surprise attack on Yaozhou; the army was destroyed in defeat.

sentences.zh: 言官交章劾奏，嚴旨切責，令戴罪圖功。

translations.literal: Censors submitted memorial after memorial to impeach him; a stern edict sharply rebuked him and ordered him to perform meritorious service while bearing his crime.
translations.idiomatic: Censors submitted memorial after memorial to impeach him; a stern edict sharply rebuked him and ordered him to redeem himself through merit while bearing his guilt.

sentences.zh: 時魏忠賢方以清君側疑承宗，其黨攻世龍者並及承宗。

translations.literal: At that time Wei Zhongxian was using the plea of "clearing away those beside the ruler" to cast suspicion on Chengzong; his faction's attacks on Shilong extended to Chengzong as well.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wei Zhongxian was casting suspicion on Chengzong under the banner of "purging those beside the ruler," and his faction's attacks on Shilong reached Chengzong as well.

sentences.zh: 承宗不安其位去，以兵部尚書高第來代。

translations.literal: Chengzong, ill at ease in his post, departed; Gao Di of the Ministry of War came to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong, uneasy in his post, left office, and Gao Di of the Ministry of War came to replace him.

sentences.zh: 職方主事徐日久者，先佐第撓遼事，及從第贊畫，力攻世龍。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Operations director Xu Rijiu had earlier assisted Gao Di in thwarting Liaodong affairs; when he followed Di as staff planner, he assailed Shilong vigorously.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Rijiu, a director in the Bureau of Operations, had earlier helped Gao Di obstruct affairs in Liaodong; when he followed Di as staff planner, he assailed Shilong with all his force.

sentences.zh: 世龍陰結忠賢，反削日久籍。

translations.literal: Shilong secretly aligned himself with Zhongxian and in turn had Rijiu stripped of his registry.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong secretly aligned himself with Zhongxian and in turn had Rijiu struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 其冬，世龍亦謝病去。

translations.literal: That winter Shilong also resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Shilong also resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 三年三月進左都督。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year he was promoted to Left Commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year he was promoted to Left Commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 時遵化、永平，遷安、灤州四城失守已三月。

translations.literal: At that time Zunhua, Yongping, Qian'an, and Luanzhou had been lost for three months.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zunhua, Yongping, Qian'an, and Luanzhou had been in enemy hands for three months.

sentences.zh: 承宗、大壽隔關門，與世龍諸軍聲息斷絕。

translations.literal: Chengzong and Dazhou were cut off beyond Shanhaiguan; with Shilong's forces all communication ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong and Dazhou were cut off beyond Shanhaiguan, and all contact with Shilong's army was lost.

sentences.zh: 帝急詔四方兵勤王，昌平尤世威、薊鎮楊肇基、保定曹鳴雷、山海宋偉、山西王國樑、固原楊麒、延綏吳自勉、臨洮王承恩、寧夏尤世祿、甘肅楊嘉謨，所將皆諸邊銳卒；

translations.literal: The Emperor urgently ordered troops from all quarters to relieve the capital: You Shiwei from Changping, Yang Zhaoji from Jizhou, Cao Minglei from Baoding, Song Wei from Shanhai, Wang Guoliang from Shanxi, Yang Qi from Guyuan, Wu Zimian from Yan-sui, Wang Chengen from Lintao, You Shilu from Ningxia, Yang Jiamou from Gansu—all leading crack troops from the border regions;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor urgently summoned troops from every quarter to relieve the capital: You Shiwei from Changping, Yang Zhaoji from Jizhou, Cao Minglei from Baoding, Song Wei from Shanhai, Wang Guoliang from Shanxi, Yang Qi from Guyuan, Wu Zimian from Yan-sui, Wang Chengen from Lintao, You Shilu from Ningxia, and Yang Jiamou from Gansu—each leading crack border troops;

sentences.zh: 內地則山東、河南、南都、湖廣、浙江、江西、福建、四川諸軍，亦先後至。

translations.literal: from the interior, armies from Shandong, Henan, the Southern Capital, Huguang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, and Sichuan also arrived in succession.
translations.idiomatic: from the interior, armies from Shandong, Henan, the Southern Capital, Huguang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, and Sichuan also arrived one after another.

sentences.zh: 並壁薊門，觀望不進。

translations.literal: They all massed at the Jizhou pass and watched without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: They all massed at the Jizhou pass and held back without advancing.

sentences.zh: 給事中張第元上言：「世龍在關數載，績效無聞，非若衛、霍之儔，功名足以服人也。

translations.literal: The supervising secretary Zhang Diyuan submitted a memorial: "Shilong has been at the pass for years with no reported achievement; he is not the equal of Wei Qing or Huo Qubing, and his fame and merit are insufficient to win men's obedience."
translations.idiomatic: The supervising secretary Zhang Diyuan submitted a memorial: "Shilong has been at the pass for years without a single achievement to his name; he is no Wei Qing or Huo Qubing, and his fame and merit are not enough to command obedience."

sentences.zh: 諸帥宿將，非世龍偏裨，欲驅策節制，誰能甘之。

translations.literal: "The commanders-in-chief and veteran generals are not Shilong's subordinates; who would willingly accept being driven and commanded under him?"
translations.idiomatic: "The senior commanders and veteran generals are not Shilong's subordinates—who would willingly accept being driven and placed under his command?"

sentences.zh: 師老財匱，銳氣日消，延及夏秋，將有不可言者。

translations.literal: "The army grows weary, funds are exhausted, and keen spirit declines day by day; if this extends into summer and autumn, there will be developments beyond words."
translations.idiomatic: "The army is worn down, funds are exhausted, and fighting spirit ebbs day by day; if this drags into summer and autumn, the consequences will be beyond words."

sentences.zh: 」帝以世龍方規進取，不納其言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor, since Shilong was then planning an advance, did not accept his words.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor, since Shilong was then planning an advance, did not heed him.

sentences.zh: 時大壽於五月十日薄灤州。

translations.literal: At that time Dazhou on the tenth day of the fifth month pressed Luanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Dazhou on the tenth day of the fifth month pressed against Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 明日，世龍等以師會。

translations.literal: The next day Shilong and the others joined forces with his army.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Shilong and the others united their forces with his.

sentences.zh: 又明日復其城。

translations.literal: The day after that they recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The day after that they retook the city.

sentences.zh: 十三日，遊擊靳國臣復遷安。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth the mobile commander Jin Guochen recovered Qian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth the mobile commander Jin Guochen recovered Qian'an.

sentences.zh: 明日，副將何可綱復永平。

translations.literal: The next day the deputy commander He Kegang recovered Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the deputy commander He Kegang recovered Yongping.

sentences.zh: 又二日，別將復遵化。

translations.literal: Two days later a separate detachment recovered Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later a separate detachment recovered Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 閱五月，四城始復。

translations.literal: After more than a month, all four cities were at last restored.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month, all four cities were at last recovered.

sentences.zh: 論功，大壽最，世祿次之。

translations.literal: In assessing merit, Dazhou ranked first and Shilu second.
translations.idiomatic: In the reckoning of merit, Dazhou ranked first and Shilu second.

sentences.zh: 世龍加太子少保，蔭本衛世千戶。

translations.literal: Shilong was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and hereditary enfeoffment as battalion commander of his original guard.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and hereditary enfeoffment as battalion commander of his original guard.

sentences.zh: 八月復謝病歸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he again resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he again resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，插漢虎墩兔合套寇犯寧夏，總兵賀虎臣戰歿，詔起世龍代之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Chahar leader Gundan and Tuman of the Ordos confederation joined in raiding Ningxia; overall commander He Huchen died in battle, and an edict recalled Shilong to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year the Chahar leaders Gundan and Tuman of the Ordos confederation joined in raiding Ningxia; overall commander He Huchen fell in battle, and an edict recalled Shilong to replace him.

sentences.zh: 世龍生長寧夏，習其形勢，大修戰備。

translations.literal: Shilong had grown up in Ningxia and knew its terrain; he greatly strengthened war preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong had grown up in Ningxia and knew its terrain well; he threw himself into strengthening the defenses.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，二部入犯，遣參將卜應第大破之，斬首二百有奇。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, when the two tribes invaded, he sent the assistant commander Bu Yingdi, who inflicted a great defeat and beheaded more than two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, when the two tribes invaded, he sent the assistant commander Bu Yingdi, who routed them and took more than two hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 逾月，套寇犯賀蘭山。

translations.literal: A month later Ordos raiders invaded Helan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: A month later Ordos raiders struck Helan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 世龍遣降丁潛入其營，馘其長撒兒甲，斬級如前。

translations.literal: Shilong sent surrendering tribesmen to infiltrate their camp and cut off the head of their leader Sa'erjia; heads taken were as before.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong sent surrendered tribesmen to infiltrate their camp and take the head of their leader Sa'erjia; the tally of heads was much the same as before.

sentences.zh: 未幾，插部大舉入寇。

translations.literal: Before long the Chahar tribes launched a major invasion.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Chahar tribes launched a major invasion.

sentences.zh: 世龍遣副將婁光先等分五道伏要害，而己中道待之，夾擊，斬首八百有奇。

translations.literal: Shilong sent the deputy commander Lou Guangxian and others to lie in ambush at five points along critical routes while he himself waited in the center; they attacked from both sides and beheaded more than eight hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong sent the deputy commander Lou Guangxian and others to lie in ambush along five routes at critical points while he himself waited in the center; they struck from both sides and took more than eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王振奇亦斬三百余級。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Wang Zhenqi also beheaded more than three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Zhenqi also took more than three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 寇復犯河西玉泉宮，世龍復邀斬五百余。

translations.literal: The raiders again invaded the Yuquan Palace west of the river; Shilong intercepted them and beheaded more than five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders again struck the Yuquan Palace west of the river; Shilong intercepted them and took more than five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 其年七月犯棗園堡，世龍又大敗之，俘斬一千有奇。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year they invaded Zaoyuan Fort; Shilong again inflicted a great defeat and captured and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year they attacked Zaoyuan Fort; Shilong again routed them, capturing and killing more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 世龍半歲中屢奏大捷，威名震西塞。

translations.literal: Within half a year Shilong repeatedly reported great victories, and his renown shook the western passes.
translations.idiomatic: Within half a year Shilong reported victory after victory, and his fame shook the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 無何，卒於官，年四十余。

translations.literal: Before long he died in office at just over forty years of age.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died in office, aged just over forty.

sentences.zh: 後論功，贈太子太傅，世錦衣僉事，賜恤如制。

translations.literal: Later, when merits were assessed, he was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, hereditary enfeoffment as Vice Commissioner of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and condolence grants according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when merits were assessed, he was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, hereditary enfeoffment as Vice Commissioner of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and condolence grants according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 楊肇基，沂州衛人。

translations.literal: Yang Zhaoji, a native of Yizhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhaoji was a native of Yizhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 起家世職，積官至大同總兵。

translations.literal: He rose from hereditary office and by accumulation of service reached overall commander at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: He began from a hereditary post and by steady advancement reached overall commander at Datong.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年，妖賊徐鴻儒反山東，連陷鄆、鉅野、鄒、滕、嶧，眾至數萬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi the sorcerer-rebel Xu Hongru rose in Shandong and in succession took Yanzhou, Juye, Zou, Teng, and Yi; his forces reached tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianqi the sorcerer-rebel Xu Hongru rebelled in Shandong and in succession seized Yan, Juye, Zou, Teng, and Yi; his followers numbered tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 巡撫趙彥任都司楊國棟、廖棟檄所部練民兵，增諸要地守卒。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhao Yan put the regional commander Yang Guodong and Liao Dong in charge of militia from their commands and increased garrison troops at key points.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhao Yan put the regional commanders Yang Guodong and Liao Dong in charge of drilling militia from their commands and increased garrison troops at key points.

sentences.zh: 時肇基方家居，彥因即家薦起之，為山東總兵官討賊。

translations.literal: At that time Zhaoji was living at home; Yan therefore summoned him from his house and had him appointed overall commander of Shandong to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoji was then living in retirement at home; Yan summoned him from his house and had him appointed overall commander of Shandong to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 未至，棟及國棟等攻鄒，兵潰，遊擊張榜戰死。

translations.literal: Before he arrived, Dong and Guodong and the rest attacked Zou; the army was routed and the mobile commander Zhang Bang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived, Dong and Guodong and the others attacked Zou; the army was routed and the mobile commander Zhang Bang fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 彥方視師兗州，遇賊。

translations.literal: Yan was then inspecting the army at Yanzhou and encountered the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was then reviewing the troops at Yanzhou when he ran into the rebels.

sentences.zh: 肇基至，急迎戰，而令國棟及棟夾擊，大敗之橫河。

translations.literal: When Zhaoji arrived he hastened to give battle and ordered Guodong and Dong to attack from both flanks; they inflicted a great defeat on them at Heng River.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaoji arrived he hastened to give battle and ordered Guodong and Dong to strike from both flanks; they inflicted a great defeat on the rebels at Heng River.

sentences.zh: 時賊精銳聚鄒、滕中道，肇基令遊兵綴賊鄒城，而以大軍擊賊黃陰、紀王城，大敗賊，蹙而殪之嶧山，遂圍鄒。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits' elite concentrated in Zou and Teng on the central route; Zhaoji ordered skirmishers to harry them at Zou city while he led the main army against them at Huangyin and Jiwangcheng, inflicted a great defeat, drove them in and destroyed them at Yishan, and then besieged Zou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels' best troops were then massed on the central route at Zou and Teng; Zhaoji ordered skirmishers to harry them at Zou while he led the main army against them at Huangyin and Jiwangcheng, routed them, drove them in and destroyed them at Yishan, and then laid siege to Zou.

sentences.zh: 國棟等亦先後收復鄆、鉅野、嶧、滕諸縣，又大破之於沙河。

translations.literal: Guodong and the others also in succession recovered Yan, Juye, Yi, and Teng and inflicted another great defeat on them at Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: Guodong and the others also recovered Yan, Juye, Yi, and Teng in turn and inflicted another great defeat on them at Shahe.

sentences.zh: 乃築長圍攻鄒。

translations.literal: They then built a long encirclement to besiege Zou.
translations.idiomatic: They then built a long encirclement to besiege Zou.

sentences.zh: 圍三月，賊食盡，其黨出降，遂擒鴻儒。

translations.literal: After three months the bandits' provisions were exhausted; their partisans came out to surrender, and Hongru was captured.
translations.idiomatic: After three months the rebels' provisions were exhausted; their followers came out to surrender, and Hongru was captured.

sentences.zh: 獻俘，磔於市，賊平。

translations.literal: The captive was presented at court and dismembered in the market; the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The captive was presented at court and dismembered in the marketplace; the rebellion was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 肇基由署都督僉事進右都督，蔭本衛世千戶。

translations.literal: Zhaoji advanced from acting Commissioner-in-chief to Right Commissioner-in-chief and received hereditary enfeoffment as battalion commander of his original guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoji advanced from acting Commissioner-in-chief to Right Commissioner-in-chief and received hereditary enfeoffment as battalion commander of his original guard.

sentences.zh: 尋代沈有容鎮登、萊。

translations.literal: Before long he replaced Shen Yourong in command of Dengzhou and Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he replaced Shen Yourong as commander of Dengzhou and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 改延綏，以擊套寇功，進左都督，蔭錦衣千戶，屢加太子太保。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Yan-sui; for his merit in striking Ordos raiders he was promoted to Left Commissioner-in-chief, enfeoffed as commander of a thousand in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and repeatedly given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yan-sui; for his merit against Ordos raiders he was promoted to Left Commissioner-in-chief, enfeoffed as commander of a thousand in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and repeatedly given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年移薊鎮西協。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen he was moved to the western sector of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongzhen he was transferred to the western sector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，大清兵克三屯營。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year Qing troops took Santunying.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year Qing forces captured Santunying.

sentences.zh: 肇基乘間收復，困守數月，卒全孤城。

translations.literal: Zhaoji seized an opening, recovered it, and though besieged for months finally preserved the isolated city intact.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoji seized an opening, retook it, and though besieged for months finally kept the isolated city intact.

sentences.zh: 蔭錦衣世千戶。

translations.literal: He received hereditary enfeoffment as battalion commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He received hereditary enfeoffment as battalion commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 已，錄恢復四城功，加太子太師，改蔭錦衣僉事。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, for the merit of recovering the four cities, he was given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and his enfeoffment was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, for recovering the four cities, he was given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and his enfeoffment was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 明年卒官。

translations.literal: The next year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died in office.

sentences.zh: 子禦蕃，見《徐從治傳》。

translations.literal: His son Yufan appears in the biography of Xu Congzhi.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yufan is treated in the biography of Xu Congzhi.

sentences.zh: 賀虎臣，保定人。

translations.literal: He Huchen, a native of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: He Huchen was a native of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，歷天津海防遊擊，登萊參將，移兗州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi he served in succession as mobile commander for Tianjin coastal defense, assistant commander at Deng-Lai, and was transferred to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he served in succession as mobile commander for Tianjin coastal defense and as assistant commander at Deng-Lai, then was transferred to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年遷延綏副總兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to deputy regional commander at Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to deputy regional commander at Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 河套寇大舉入犯，從帥楊肇基協擊，大破之。

translations.literal: When Ordos raiders invaded on a large scale he joined Commander Yang Zhaoji in a coordinated attack and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When Ordos raiders invaded on a large scale he joined Commander Yang Zhaoji in a coordinated strike and inflicted a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 加署都督僉事。

translations.literal: He was given the additional post of acting Commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the additional post of acting Commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年，捕誅階州叛卒周大旺等。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongzhen he hunted down and executed the Jiezhou mutineers Zhou Dawang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongzhen he hunted down and executed the Jiezhou mutineers Zhou Dawang and others.

sentences.zh: 擢總兵官，鎮守寧夏。

translations.literal: He was promoted to overall commander and posted to defend Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to overall commander and posted to defend Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 關中賊大起，王嘉胤陷清水營，殺遊擊李顯宗，遂陷府谷。

translations.literal: Bandits in Guanzhong rose on a grand scale; Wang Jiayin took Qingshui Camp, killed the mobile commander Li Xianzong, and then took Fugu.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits in Guanzhong rose on a grand scale; Wang Jiayin seized Qingshui Camp, killed the mobile commander Li Xianzong, and then took Fugu.

sentences.zh: 其黨李老柴應之，嘯聚三千余人，攻合水。

translations.literal: His follower Li Laocai responded, gathering more than three thousand men to attack Heshui.
translations.idiomatic: His follower Li Laocai answered the call, mustering more than three thousand men to attack Heshui.

sentences.zh: 總督楊鶴檄虎臣往討，擊之盤谷，俘馘六百有奇。

translations.literal: Governor-General Yang He issued orders to Huchen to go suppress them; he attacked them at Pangu Valley and captured and beheaded more than six hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yang He ordered Huchen to march against the rebels; at Pangu Valley he routed them, taking more than six hundred heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 已，擊斬慶陽賊渠劉六。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he attacked and beheaded Liu Liu, the bandit chieftain of Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he attacked and killed Liu Liu, the Qingyang bandit leader.

sentences.zh: 四年，神一元陷保安。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Shen Yiyuan took Bao'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Shen Yiyuan seized Bao'an.

sentences.zh: 延安告急，延綏撫鎮皆東援陜西。

translations.literal: Yan'an reported urgent distress; the Yan-sui circuit intendant and garrison commanders all marched east to relieve Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan'an sent urgent pleas for help; the Yan-sui circuit intendant and garrison commanders all marched east to relieve Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 巡撫練國事檄虎臣及副將李卑援剿。

translations.literal: Circuit intendant Lian Guoshi issued orders to Huchen and Vice Commander Li Bei to reinforce and join the suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit intendant Lian Guoshi ordered Huchen and Vice Commander Li Bei to march in relief and join the suppression campaign.

sentences.zh: 虎臣等遂進圍保安，賊引河套數千騎挫虎臣軍。

translations.literal: Huchen and his men then advanced to besiege Bao'an; the bandits brought several thousand Ordos horsemen to check Huchen's army.
translations.idiomatic: Huchen and his men then advanced to besiege Bao'an, but the rebels brought down several thousand Ordos horsemen and checked Huchen's army.

sentences.zh: 會張應昌擊敗之，賊眾棄城去。

translations.literal: Just then Zhang Yingchang attacked and defeated them, and the bandit horde abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: At that moment Zhang Yingchang attacked and routed them, and the rebel force abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 虎臣等前後獲首功一千九百。

translations.literal: Huchen and his men in all claimed credit for nineteen hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: In all, Huchen and his men claimed credit for nineteen hundred enemy heads.

sentences.zh: 明年，可天飛、郝臨庵、劉道江、李都司再圍合水。

translations.literal: The next year Ketianfei, Hao Lin'an, Liu Daojiang, and Commander Li again besieged Heshui.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Ketianfei, Hao Lin'an, Liu Daojiang, and Commander Li again besieged Heshui.

sentences.zh: 虎臣偕臨洮曹文詔、甘肅楊嘉謨、固原楊麒合擊，大破賊甘泉之虎兕凹，斬首七百有奇，賊大困。

translations.literal: Huchen together with Cao Wenzhao of Lintao, Yang Jiamo of Gansu, and Yang Qi of Guyuan launched a joint attack and routed the bandits at Huxiao'ao in Ganquan, beheading more than seven hundred; the bandits were greatly hard pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Huchen joined forces with Cao Wenzhao of Lintao, Yang Jiamo of Gansu, and Yang Qi of Guyuan and together shattered the rebels at Huxiao'ao in Ganquan, taking more than seven hundred heads; the rebels were left in dire straits.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，插漢虎墩兔合套寇五萬騎自清水、橫城分道入。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year Chaha Erdengji of Chakhar combined with Ordos raiders—fifty thousand horsemen—and entered by separate routes from Qingshui and Hengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year Chaha Erdengji of Chakhar joined with Ordos raiders in a force of fifty thousand horsemen that entered by separate routes from Qingshui and Hengcheng.

sentences.zh: 守備姚之夔等不能禦，沙井驛副將史開先、臨河堡參將張問政、嶽家樓守備趙訪皆潰逃。

translations.literal: Defending commander Yao Zhikui and others could not resist; Vice Commander Shi Kaixian of Shajing Station, Assistant Commander Zhang Wenzheng of Linhe Fort, and Defending Commander Zhao Fang of Yuejialou all broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Defending commander Yao Zhikui and others could not hold them off; Vice Commander Shi Kaixian at Shajing Station, Assistant Commander Zhang Wenzheng at Linhe Fort, and Defending Commander Zhao Fang at Yuejialou all broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 寇遂進薄靈州，虎臣急領千騎入守。

translations.literal: The raiders then pressed close to Lingzhou; Huchen hurriedly led a thousand horsemen inside to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders then pressed close to Lingzhou, and Huchen hurriedly led a thousand horsemen into the city to hold it.

sentences.zh: 旋盡勒城中兵出擊，次大沙井。

translations.literal: He then mustered all the troops in the city to sortie in attack, halting at Dashajing.
translations.idiomatic: He soon mustered every soldier in the city for a sortie, taking position at Dashajing.

sentences.zh: 寇從漢伯堡突至，虎臣軍未及布陳，且眾寡不敵，遂戰死。

translations.literal: Raiders suddenly arrived from Hanbo Fort; Huchen's army had not yet deployed its formations, and moreover was outnumbered, so he died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders burst forth from Hanbo Fort before Huchen's men could form battle lines; heavily outnumbered, he was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 子贊挾五十騎突重圍出。

translations.literal: His son Zan, clasping fifty horsemen, broke through the heavy encirclement and got out.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zan broke through the heavy encirclement with fifty horsemen and escaped.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈虎臣都督僉事，賜祭葬，世蔭指揮僉事。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Huchen was posthumously granted the post of Commissioner-in-chief, given sacrificial honors and burial, and his heirs were granted hereditary rank as Battalion Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When word of his death reached the throne, Huchen was posthumously invested as Commissioner-in-chief, granted state funeral rites, and his heirs received hereditary rank as battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 尋錄先後剿寇功，再贈都督同知，世蔭錦衣副千戶。

translations.literal: Soon his successive merits in suppressing bandits were recorded; he was again posthumously granted Vice Commissioner-in-chief, and his heirs were granted hereditary rank as Vice Centurion in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward his past merits in bandit suppression were officially recorded; he was posthumously promoted again to Vice Commissioner-in-chief, and his heirs were given hereditary rank as vice centurion in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 贊，勇敢有父風。

translations.literal: Zan was brave and had his father's bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Zan was courageous and carried his father's martial spirit.

sentences.zh: 既承蔭，尋舉武進士。

translations.literal: Having inherited the hereditary post, he soon passed the military jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: After inheriting the hereditary office he soon passed the military jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 積官至京營副將。

translations.literal: He rose through offices to Vice Commander of the Capital Garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to vice commander of the capital garrisons.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十七年三月，李自成薄京師，京軍六大營分列城外，皆不敢戰，或棄甲降。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventeenth year of Chongzhen, Li Zicheng pressed close to the capital; the capital army's six great camps were arrayed outside the walls, but none dared fight, and some cast off armor and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Chongzhen seventeen Li Zicheng closed on the capital; the six great camps of the capital garrison were posted outside the walls, yet none dared give battle—some even cast off their armor and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 贊獨率部卒迎擊，中矢死。

translations.literal: Zan alone led his troops to meet them in attack and was killed by an arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Zan alone led his troops forward to meet the attack and was killed by an arrow.

sentences.zh: 弟誠，身長七尺，美須髯，為諸生，以忠義自許。

translations.literal: His younger brother Cheng was seven chi in height, with handsome beard and whiskers; he was a licentiate student and prided himself on loyalty and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Cheng stood seven chi tall, with a fine beard and whiskers; a student of the classics, he held himself to a standard of loyalty and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 兄誡襲副千戶，早卒，無子，誠當襲，以讓其弟詮。

translations.literal: His elder brother Jie inherited the vice centurion post, died early, and had no son; Cheng ought to have inherited, but yielded it to his younger brother Quan.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Jie had inherited the vice centurion post but died young without an heir; the succession should have passed to Cheng, yet he yielded it to his younger brother Quan.

sentences.zh: 及賊陷保定，家人勸易衣遁。

translations.literal: When the bandits took Baoding, his family urged him to change clothes and flee.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels seized Baoding, his family urged him to change clothes and flee.

sentences.zh: 叱曰：「吾忠臣子，偷生而逃，何以見先將軍地下！

translations.literal: He rebuked them, saying: "I am the son of a loyal minister—if I seek to save my life and flee, how could I face the late general below ground!
translations.idiomatic: He rebuked them: "I am the son of a loyal minister. If I clung to life and fled, how could I face my father, the late general, in the grave!

sentences.zh: 」遂偕妻女投井死。

translations.literal: " He then together with his wife and daughters threw themselves into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: " With that he took his wife and daughters and drowned themselves in a well.

sentences.zh: 沈有容，字士弘，宣城人。

translations.literal: Shen Yourong, courtesy name Shihong, was a native of Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yourong, courtesy name Shihong, was a native of Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 僉事寵之孫也。

translations.literal: He was the grandson of Assistant Commissioner Shen Chong.
translations.idiomatic: He was the grandson of Assistant Commissioner Shen Chong.

sentences.zh: 幼走馬擊劍，好兵略。

translations.literal: From youth he rode horses and practiced swordplay, loving military strategy.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood he rode horses and practiced swordplay, and loved the art of war.

sentences.zh: 舉萬歷七年武鄉試。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Wanli he passed the military provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military provincial examination in the seventh year of the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 薊遼總督梁夢龍見而異之，用為昌平千總。

translations.literal: Ji-Liao Governor-General Liang Menglong saw him and considered him extraordinary, employing him as a chiliarch at Changping.
translations.idiomatic: Ji-Liao Governor-General Liang Menglong saw him and was struck by his talent, appointing him chiliarch at Changping.

sentences.zh: 復受知總督張佳胤，調薊鎮東路，轄南兵後營。

translations.literal: He again won the recognition of Governor-General Zhang Jiayin, was transferred to the eastern route of the Ji garrison, and commanded the Rear Camp of southern troops.
translations.idiomatic: He again won favor with Governor-General Zhang Jiayin, was transferred to the eastern route of the Ji garrison, and took command of the Rear Camp of southern troops.

sentences.zh: 十二年秋，朵顏長昂以三千騎犯劉家口。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twelfth year, Duoyan leader Chang Ang invaded Liujiakou with three thousand horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twelfth year the Duoyan chieftain Chang Ang crossed into Liujiakou at the head of three thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 有容夜半率健卒二十九人迎擊，身中二矢，斬首六級，寇退乃還，由是知名。

translations.literal: Yourong at midnight led twenty-nine picked soldiers to meet them in attack; he took two arrows in his body, beheaded six heads, and returned only after the raiders withdrew—thereby becoming renowned.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight Yourong led twenty-nine picked soldiers to meet the attack; though twice wounded by arrows he took six heads before the raiders withdrew and he returned, and from that day his name was known.

sentences.zh: 遼東巡撫顧養謙召隸麾下，俾練火器。

translations.literal: Liaodong Circuit Intendant Gu Yangqian summoned him to serve under his command and had him drill with firearms.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong circuit intendant Gu Yangqian brought him into his staff and set him to drilling troops in the use of firearms.

sentences.zh: 十四年從李成梁出塞，抵可可毋林，斬馘多。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he followed Li Chengliang beyond the frontier to Kekeumulin, taking many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he followed Li Chengliang on a campaign beyond the frontier to Kekeumulin, where he took many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 明年再出，亦有功。

translations.literal: The next year he went out again and likewise achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he campaigned beyond the frontier again and won further distinction.

sentences.zh: 成梁攻北關，有容陷陣，馬再易再斃，卒拔其城。

translations.literal: When Chengliang attacked Beiguan, Yourong broke into the enemy ranks; his horses were changed twice and both were killed, yet in the end he stormed the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Chengliang's assault on Beiguan, Yourong fought at the front of the battle; he changed horses twice after both were killed, yet in the end stormed the place.

sentences.zh: 錄功，世蔭千戶。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and his heirs were granted hereditary rank as Centurion.
translations.idiomatic: His merits were officially recorded and his heirs received hereditary rank as centurion.

sentences.zh: 遷都司僉書，守浮屠谷。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Assistant Director in the regional command and defended Futugu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to assistant director in the regional command and posted to defend Futugu Valley.

sentences.zh: 從宋應昌援朝鮮，乞歸。

translations.literal: He followed Song Yingchang in aiding Korea, then requested to return home.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Song Yingchang to Korea in the relief campaign, then asked to be released from service and return home.

sentences.zh: 日本封事壞，福建巡撫金學曾欲用奇搗其穴，起有容守浯嶼、銅山。

translations.literal: When the Japanese investiture affair collapsed, Fujian Circuit Intendant Jin Xueceng wished to use a daring stroke to strike their lair; Yourong was recalled to guard Wuyu and Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Japanese investiture mission ended in failure, Fujian circuit intendant Jin Xueceng planned a bold raid on the enemy's base and had Yourong recalled to garrison Wuyu and Tongshan.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，倭掠諸寨，有容擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Japanese pirates raided the various stockades; Yourong attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Japanese pirates raided the coastal stockades, and Yourong routed them.

sentences.zh: 逾月，與銅山把總張萬紀敗倭彭山洋。

translations.literal: More than a month later, together with Tongshan Company Commander Zhang Wanji he defeated the Japanese at Pengshan Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: A little over a month later he and Tongshan company commander Zhang Wanji defeated the Japanese at Pengshan Ocean.

sentences.zh: 倭據東番。

translations.literal: The Japanese occupied Dongfan.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese pirates seized hold of Dongfan.

sentences.zh: 有容守石湖，謀盡殲之，以二十一舟出海，遇風，存十四舟。

translations.literal: Yourong defended Shihu, planned to annihilate them completely, and set out to sea with twenty-one ships; encountering wind, only fourteen ships remained.
translations.idiomatic: Yourong was garrisoned at Shihu and planned their complete destruction; he put to sea with twenty-one vessels, but a storm left only fourteen.

sentences.zh: 過彭湖，與倭遇，格殺數人，縱火沈其六舟，斬首十五級，奪還男婦三百七十余人。

translations.literal: Passing Penghu, they encountered the Japanese, killed several in close combat, set fire and sank six of their ships, beheaded fifteen heads, and recovered more than three hundred seventy men and women.
translations.idiomatic: Off Penghu they met the Japanese fleet, killed several in boarding action, burned and sank six of their ships, took fifteen heads, and freed more than three hundred seventy captives.

sentences.zh: 倭遂去東番，海上息肩者十年。

translations.literal: The Japanese then left Dongfan, and the sea had respite for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese then quit Dongfan, and the coast enjoyed a decade of peace.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，文武將吏悉敘功，有容賚白金而已。

translations.literal: When news of victory arrived, civil and military officers and officials all had merits recorded; Yourong received only an award of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory reached court, civil and military officers up and down the ranks were all rewarded for their merits—but Yourong received only a grant of silver.

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月，西洋紅毛番長韋麻郎駕三大艘至彭湖，求互市，稅使高寀召之也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year, the Western Red-Haired chieftain Weymel arrived at Penghu in three large ships seeking mutual trade—it was Tax Commissioner Gao Cai who had summoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year the Western "Red-Haired" chieftain Weymel sailed three large ships to Penghu to petition for trade—it was Tax Commissioner Gao Cai who had summoned him.

sentences.zh: 有容白當事，自請往諭。

translations.literal: Yourong informed those in authority and volunteered to go admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: Yourong reported the matter to his superiors and volunteered to go and remonstrate with them.

sentences.zh: 見麻郎，指陳利害。

translations.literal: Meeting Weymel, he pointed out and set forth the advantages and harms.
translations.idiomatic: When he met Weymel he laid out the risks and consequences in plain terms.

sentences.zh: 麻郎悟，呼寀使者，索還所賂寀金，揚帆去。

translations.literal: Weymel understood, called Gao Cai's envoy, demanded back the gold bribed to Gao Cai, and set sail and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Weymel took his meaning, summoned Gao Cai's envoy, demanded return of the gold he had paid Gao Cai as a bribe, and sailed away.

sentences.zh: 改僉書浙江都司。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Assistant Director of the Zhejiang Regional Command.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as assistant director of the Zhejiang regional command.

sentences.zh: 由浙江遊擊調天津，遷溫處參將，罷歸。

translations.literal: From Zhejiang mobile commander he was transferred to Tianjin, promoted to Wenzhou-Chuzhou Assistant Commander, then dismissed and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He went from mobile commander in Zhejiang to a posting at Tianjin, was promoted to assistant commander at Wenzhou-Chuzhou, and was then dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，倭犯福建。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, Japanese pirates invaded Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year Japanese pirates attacked Fujian.

sentences.zh: 巡撫黃承元請特設水師，起有容統之，擒倭東沙。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant Huang Chengyuan requested that a naval force be specially established; Yourong was recalled to command it and captured Japanese pirates at Dongsha.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit intendant Huang Chengyuan petitioned for a dedicated naval force; Yourong was recalled to command it and captured Japanese raiders at Dongsha.

sentences.zh: 尋招降巨寇袁進、李忠，散遣其眾。

translations.literal: Soon he received the surrender of the great bandits Yuan Jin and Li Zhong and dispersed their followers.
translations.idiomatic: He soon persuaded the great bandit leaders Yuan Jin and Li Zhong to surrender and dispersed their followers.

sentences.zh: 張可大，字觀甫，應天人。

translations.literal: Zhang Keda, courtesy name Guanfu, was a native of Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Keda, courtesy name Guanfu, was a native of Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 世襲南京羽林左衛千戶，舉萬歷二十九年武會試，授建昌守備。

translations.literal: He inherited the hereditary post of Centurion in the Nanjing Left Imperial Guard, passed the metropolitan military examination in the twenty-ninth year of Wanli, and was appointed defending commander at Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: A hereditary centurion in the Nanjing Left Imperial Guard, he passed the metropolitan military examination in Wanli twenty-nine and was appointed defending commander at Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 遷浙江都司僉書，分守瓜洲、儀真，江洋大盜斂跡。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Assistant Director of the Zhejiang Regional Command, posted to garrison Guazhou and Yizhen; the great river pirates kept their tracks hidden.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to assistant director of the Zhejiang regional command with responsibility for Guazhou and Yizhen, where the great river pirates ceased their depredations.

sentences.zh: 稅監魯保死，淮撫李三才令可大錄其貲。

translations.literal: When Tax Commissioner Lu Bao died, Huai Circuit Intendant Li Sancai ordered Keda to inventory his property.
translations.idiomatic: When the tax commissioner Lu Bao died, Huai circuit intendant Li Sancai ordered Keda to inventory his estate.

sentences.zh: 保家饋重賄，卻不受。

translations.literal: Bao's family presented heavy bribes, but he refused to accept them.
translations.idiomatic: Bao's family offered him large bribes, which he refused.

sentences.zh: 葉向高赴召過儀，見而異之，曰：「此不特良將，且良吏也。

translations.literal: Ye Xiang'ao, on being summoned to court, passed through Yizhen, saw him and considered him extraordinary, saying: "This man is not merely a good general but also a good administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Xiang'ao, traveling to court on imperial summons, passed through Yizhen, met him and was struck by his character, saying: "This man is not only a fine general but a fine official as well.

sentences.zh: 」遷劉河遊擊，改廣東高肇參將。

translations.literal: " He was transferred to mobile commander at Liuhe, then changed to Assistant Commander at Gaozhao in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: " He was transferred to mobile commander at Liuhe, then reassigned as assistant commander at Gaozhao in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 調浙江舟山。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Zhoushan in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Zhoushan in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 奉命征黎，與總兵王鳴鶴用黑番為導，搗其巢，黎乃滅。

translations.literal: Ordered to campaign against the Li, together with Overall Commander Wang Minghe he used Black Fan tribesmen as guides, smashed their lair, and thus the Li were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to campaign against the Li, he and overall commander Wang Minghe used Black Fan tribesmen as guides, struck their stronghold, and brought the Li rebellion to an end.

sentences.zh: 劉興治反東江，遂奉詔還鎮。

translations.literal: Liu Xingzhi rebelled in the Eastern River district, and he then received an imperial order to return to his post.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Xingzhi rebelled in the eastern frontier he received an imperial order to return to his garrison command.

sentences.zh: 已而四城並復，朝議復設登萊巡撫，以孫元化為之。

translations.literal: Before long the four cities were all recovered; court deliberation restored the Deng-Lai circuit intendant post, with Sun Yuanhua appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Before long all four cities were retaken; the court decided to restore the Deng-Lai circuit intendant post and appointed Sun Yuanhua to it.

sentences.zh: 元化率關外八千人至，強半皆遼人。

translations.literal: Yuanhua led eight thousand men from beyond the pass to arrive; more than half were Liaodong men.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yuanhua arrived at the head of eight thousand troops from beyond the pass, more than half of them natives of Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 可大慮有變，屢言於元化，不聽。

translations.literal: Keda feared there would be trouble, repeatedly spoke to Yuanhua about it, but was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Keda feared trouble and warned Yuanhua repeatedly, but Yuanhua would not listen.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，錄前守城功，進右都督。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, his earlier merit in defending the city was recorded and he was promoted to Right Commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year his prior merit in holding the city was officially recorded and he was promoted to Right Commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十月，僉書南京左府，兼督池河、浦口二軍，登人泣留之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, he was appointed Recorder of the Nanjing Left Regional Military Commission, concurrently supervising the Chihe and Pukou armies; the people of Deng wept and begged him to stay.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was appointed recorder of the Nanjing Left Regional Military Commission with concurrent command over the Chihe and Pukou armies; the people of Deng wept and begged him to remain.

sentences.zh: 未行而孔有德反吳橋，東陷六城。

translations.literal: Before he could depart, Kong Youde rebelled at Wuqiao and eastward seized six cities.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could depart, Kong Youde rebelled at Wuqiao and seized six cities to the east.

sentences.zh: 可大急往剿，元化檄止之，不聽。

translations.literal: Keda hastened to suppress him; Yuanhua issued orders to halt him, but he did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Keda rushed to suppress the rebels, but Yuanhua ordered him to stand down—and he refused.

sentences.zh: 次萊州，遇元化，復為所阻，乃還鎮。

translations.literal: Halting at Laizhou, he met Yuanhua and was again blocked by him, so he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Laizhou and met Yuanhua he was blocked again, and so returned to his command.

sentences.zh: 歲將晏，有德暮薄城。

translations.literal: As the year was nearing its end, Youde at dusk pressed close to the city.
translations.idiomatic: As the year drew to a close, Youde approached the city walls at dusk.

sentences.zh: 可大請擊之，元化持撫議，不許。

translations.literal: Keda requested to attack him; Yuanhua held to a policy of pacification and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Keda urged an attack, but Yuanhua clung to a policy of conciliation and refused.

sentences.zh: 可大陳利害甚切，元化期明歲元日發兵合擊。

translations.literal: Keda set forth the advantages and harms with great urgency; Yuanhua fixed the New Year's Day of the coming year for dispatching troops in a joint attack.
translations.idiomatic: Keda pressed the urgency of the situation in the strongest terms; Yuanhua promised a joint attack on New Year's Day of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 至期，元化兵不發。

translations.literal: When the day arrived, Yuanhua's troops were not sent out.
translations.idiomatic: When the day came, Yuanhua failed to dispatch his troops.

sentences.zh: 明日，合兵戰城東，可大兵屢勝。

translations.literal: The next day, the combined armies fought east of the city; Keda's troops repeatedly prevailed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the allied forces fought east of the city, and Keda's troops won victory after victory.

sentences.zh: 元化部卒皆遼人，親黨多，無鬥誌。

translations.literal: Yuanhua's troops were all Liaodong men, with many close associates, and lacked fighting spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhua's troops were nearly all Liaodong men with many ties among the rebels, and they showed little will to fight.

sentences.zh: 其將張燾先走，可大兵亦敗。

translations.literal: His general Zhang Tao fled first, and Keda's troops also were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: His general Zhang Tao broke and ran first, and Keda's force was defeated as well.

sentences.zh: 中軍管維城，遊擊陳良謨，守備盛洛、姚士良皆戰死。

translations.literal: Chief of staff Guan Weicheng, Mobile Commander Chen Liangmo, and Defending Commanders Sheng Luo and Yao Shiliang all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Chief of staff Guan Weicheng, mobile commander Chen Liangmo, and defending commanders Sheng Luo and Yao Shiliang all fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 燾兵半降有德，遣歸為內應。

translations.literal: Half of Tao's troops surrendered to Youde, who sent them back as inside collaborators.
translations.idiomatic: Half of Zhang Tao's men surrendered to Youde, who sent them back as saboteurs within the walls.

sentences.zh: 元化開門納之，可大諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Yuanhua opened the gate and admitted them; Keda remonstrated, but he did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhua opened the gates and let them in; Keda protested but was overruled.

sentences.zh: 夜半賊至，城遂陷。

translations.literal: At midnight the bandits arrived and the city was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight the rebels struck and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 可大時守水城，撫膺大慟。

translations.literal: Keda was then defending the water city; he beat his breast and wailed greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Keda was holding the water fortress; he clutched his chest and wept in anguish.

sentences.zh: 解所佩印付旗鼓，間道走濟南上之。

translations.literal: He removed the seal he wore and entrusted it to the flag-and-drum officer, then by a hidden path fled to Jinan and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: He removed the seal at his belt and entrusted it to his standard-bearer, then slipped away by a back route to Jinan and surrendered it to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 還家辭母，令弟可度、子鹿征奉母航海趨天津。

translations.literal: Returning home to bid farewell to his mother, he ordered his younger brother Kedou and son Luzheng to escort his mother by sea toward Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: He went home to take leave of his mother, directing his younger brother Kedou and his son Luzheng to escort her by sea to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 而以佩劍付部將，盡斬諸婢妾，遂投繯死。

translations.literal: He then entrusted his worn sword to a subordinate general, executed all his maidservants and concubines, and then hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: He gave his sword to a subordinate officer, had every maidservant and concubine put to death, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈特進榮祿大夫、太子少傅，謚莊節，賜祭葬，予世蔭，建祠曰：「旌忠」。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously granted Special Advancement Grand Master of the Glorious Blessings, Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince, given the posthumous title Zhuangjie, granted sacrificial honors and burial, given hereditary rank, and a temple was built called "Commemorating Loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne he was posthumously invested as Special Advancement Grand Master of the Glorious Blessings and Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince, honored with the posthumous title Zhuangjie ("Steadfast Integrity"), granted state funeral rites and hereditary rank, and a memorial shrine was erected under the name "Commemorating Loyalty."

sentences.zh: 可大好學能詩，敦節行，有儒將風。

translations.literal: Keda loved learning and could compose poetry, was earnest in conduct, and had the bearing of a scholar-general.
translations.idiomatic: Keda was devoted to learning and wrote poetry, lived by strict principles, and bore the dignified manner of a scholar-general.

sentences.zh: 為南京錦衣時，歐陽暉由刑部主事謫本衛知事，嘗賦詩有「陰霾國事非」句，揚州知府劉鐸書之扇，贈一僧。

translations.literal: When serving in the Nanjing Embroidered Uniform Guard, Ouyang Hui was demoted from main director in the Ministry of Justice to clerk of this guard; he once composed a poem with the line "gloom over state affairs is wrong," which Yangzhou prefect Liu Duo wrote on a fan and gave to a monk.
translations.idiomatic: While he held office in the Nanjing Embroidered Uniform Guard, Ouyang Hui was demoted from a main directorship in the Ministry of Justice to a clerk in that guard; he once wrote a poem containing the line "the nation's affairs are shrouded in gloom," which Yangzhou prefect Liu Duo copied onto a fan and gave to a monk.

sentences.zh: 惡鐸者譖之魏忠賢，暉、鐸俱被逮。

translations.literal: One who hated Duo slandered them to Wei Zhongxian, and Hui and Duo were both arrested.
translations.idiomatic: An enemy of Liu Duo denounced them to Wei Zhongxian, and both Hui and Duo were arrested.

sentences.zh: 可大約束旗尉，捐奉助之，卜室處其妻子。

translations.literal: Keda restrained the banner guards and centurions, donated his salary to assist them, and found a dwelling to house their wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: Keda kept his banner guards and centurions in check, contributed from his own salary to help them, and found housing for their wives and children.

sentences.zh: 其尚義類如此。

translations.literal: His upholding of righteousness was of this sort.
translations.idiomatic: In matters of righteousness he acted in just this way.

sentences.zh: 弟可仕，字文峙，以字行。

translations.literal: His younger brother Keshi, courtesy name Wenzhi, was known by his courtesy name.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Keshi, courtesy name Wenzhi, went by his courtesy name.

sentences.zh: 隱居博學，嘗輯明布衣詩一百卷。

translations.literal: He lived in seclusion and was widely learned; he once compiled one hundred volumes of poetry by commoners of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in retirement as a scholar, and once compiled one hundred volumes of poetry by commoners of the Ming dynasty.

sentences.zh: 都勻凱裏土司者，運道咽喉也，邦彥結諸蠻困其城，長官楊世蔚不能守。

translations.literal: The native chieftain of Duyun-Kaili was the throat of the supply route; An Bangyan gathered the various tribes to besiege its city, and District Commander Yang Shiwei could not hold it.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftain of Duyun-Kaili controlled a vital supply corridor; An Bangyan rallied the tribal forces to besiege the city, and District Commander Yang Shiwei could not hold out.

sentences.zh: 總督蔡復一遣欽及總兵官劉超救之，拔賊巖頭寨，遂移師克平茶。

translations.literal: Governor-General Cai Fuyi sent Qin and Overall Commander Liu Chao to relieve it; they took the bandit stronghold at Yantou Stockade, then shifted their army and captured Pingcha.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Cai Fuyi dispatched Qin and overall commander Liu Chao to the rescue; they stormed the rebel stronghold at Yantou Stockade, then marched on and captured Pingcha.

sentences.zh: 已而邦彥盡驅羅鬼，結四十營於斑鳩灣後寨，互二十餘里，分犯普定。

translations.literal: Before long Bangyan drove out all the Luogui tribesmen and established forty camps at the rear stockade of Banjiuwan, stretching more than twenty li, and sent separate forces to invade Puding.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Bangyan mustered the Luogui tribesmen and established forty camps at the rear stockade of Banjiuwan, spread over more than twenty li, then launched separate attacks on Puding.

sentences.zh: 復一令欽與總兵官黃鉞分道禦之。

translations.literal: Fuyi ordered Qin and Overall Commander Huang Yue to defend against them by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyi ordered Qin and overall commander Huang Yue to meet the threat along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 欽率部將張雲鵬、劉誌敏、鄧玘等大敗賊汪家沖。

translations.literal: Qin led his subordinate generals Zhang Yunpeng, Liu Zhimin, Deng Qi, and others to inflict a great defeat on the bandits at Wangjiachong.
translations.idiomatic: Qin led subordinate generals Zhang Yunpeng, Liu Zhimin, Deng Qi, and others to a crushing victory over the rebels at Wangjiachong.

sentences.zh: 鉞及參政陸夢龍、副使楊世賞亦大敗賊蔣義寨。

translations.literal: Yue together with Administration Commissioner Lu Menglong and Vice Commissioner Yang Shishang also inflicted a great defeat on the bandits at Jiangyizhai.
translations.idiomatic: Yue, together with administration commissioner Lu Menglong and vice commissioner Yang Shishang, also routed the rebels at Jiangyizhai.

sentences.zh: 合追至河，斬首千五百余級。

translations.literal: Together they pursued to the river and beheaded more than fifteen hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: The combined forces pursued the enemy to the river and took more than fifteen hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 搜山，復斬六百余級。

translations.literal: Searching the mountains, they beheaded more than six hundred additional heads.
translations.idiomatic: In sweeps through the mountains they took more than six hundred additional heads.

sentences.zh: 尹伸守普定，亦敗賊兵，與大軍會，共剪水外逆苗。

translations.literal: Yin Shen defended Puding and also defeated the bandit troops; joining the main army, they together exterminated the rebellious Miao beyond the river.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shen, holding Puding, also defeated the rebel force; when he joined the main army they together wiped out the rebellious Miao tribes west of the river.

sentences.zh: 邦彥勢窘，渡河西奔。

translations.literal: Bangyan's situation grew desperate, and he crossed the river and fled west.
translations.idiomatic: Bangyan's position collapsed, and he crossed the river and fled westward.

sentences.zh: 欽、鉞督諸將窮追，夢龍等分駐三岔河岸為後勁。

translations.literal: Qin and Yue supervised the generals in relentless pursuit; Menglong and others were posted separately along the banks of the San Cha River as rear support.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Yue drove the generals in relentless pursuit while Menglong and others held positions along the San Cha River as a reserve force.

sentences.zh: 前鋒雲鵬、玘等深入織金，先後斬首千余級。

translations.literal: The vanguard Yunpeng, Qi, and others penetrated deep into Zhijin and in succession beheaded more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: The vanguard under Yunpeng and Qi pushed deep into Zhijin and in a series of engagements took more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 復一上其功，言：「欽廉勇。

translations.literal: Fuyi submitted a report on their merits, saying: "Qin is upright and brave.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyi memorialized the court on their achievements, writing: "Qin is upright and courageous.

sentences.zh: 雖名總理，權力不當一偏裨。

translations.literal: Although titled overall manager, his authority was not equal to that of a single subordinate commander.
translations.idiomatic: Although he bore the title of overall manager, his authority amounted to less than that of a single subordinate commander.

sentences.zh: 舊撫臣三善及諸監軍，人人為大帥，內莊失律，欽不當獨任大帥罪。

translations.literal: The former circuit intendant San Shan and the various military overseers each acted as grand commanders; discipline within the camps broke down, and Qin ought not bear alone the guilt of a grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: The former circuit intendant Wang San Shan and the various military overseers each acted as supreme commanders in his own right; discipline in the camps collapsed, and Qin should not bear a grand commander's guilt alone.

sentences.zh: 臣至黔，以諸道監軍兵盡屬欽，每戰身先士卒。

translations.literal: When your subject arrived in Guizhou, he placed all the troops of the various circuit overseers under Qin, and in every battle he led from the front ahead of his soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Since I arrived in Guizhou I have placed all troops under the circuit overseers under Qin's command, and in every battle he has led from the front.

sentences.zh: 欽敗可原，勝足錄。

translations.literal: Qin's defeats may be forgiven; his victories are sufficient to be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Qin's defeats may be forgiven; his victories are more than enough to merit official recognition.

sentences.zh: 當免其戴罪，仍以功論。

translations.literal: He should be released from bearing guilt and judged instead by his merits.
translations.idiomatic: He should be cleared of his punitive assignment and rewarded according to his merits.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The court assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，欽等渡河還，中伏，敗死者數千人。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year, Qin and the others crossed the river on their return, fell into an ambush, and several thousand were killed in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year Qin and his men crossed the river on the return march, walked into an ambush, and lost several thousand dead.

sentences.zh: 充為事官，立功自贖。

translations.literal: He was reduced to serving as an officer on punitive assignment, to redeem himself through merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to punitive assignment and ordered to redeem himself through further service.

sentences.zh: 自平越至興隆、清平二衛，苗二百余寨盤踞其間，以長田之天保、阿秧為魁。

translations.literal: From Pingyue to the two garrisons of Xinglong and Qingping, more than two hundred Miao stockades occupied the region, with Tianbao and Ayang of Changtian as their chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: From Pingyue to the garrisons of Xinglong and Qingping, more than two hundred Miao stockades held the region, led by Tianbao and Ayang of Changtian.

sentences.zh: 邦彥初反，授二酋都督，使通下六衛聲息。

translations.literal: When Bangyan first rebelled, he granted the two chiefs the rank of regional commander and had them communicate intelligence with the six lower garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: When Bangyan first rose in rebellion he invested the two chieftains as regional commanders and used them to maintain contact with the six lower garrisons.

sentences.zh: 是年春，寇石阡、余慶。

translations.literal: That spring they raided Shiqian and Yuqing.
translations.idiomatic: That spring they raided Shiqian and Yuqing.

sentences.zh: 監軍按察使來斯行啖阿秧，使圖天保，阿秧反以情告。

translations.literal: Military overseer and surveillance commissioner Laisixing used enticements on Ayang and had him plot against Tianbao, but Ayang instead revealed the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Military overseer and surveillance commissioner Laisixing tried to win Ayang over and set him against Tianbao, but Ayang turned informer instead.

sentences.zh: 斯行乃誘斬阿秧，議討天保，會以疾去。

translations.literal: Laisixing then lured and executed Ayang and proposed a campaign against Tianbao, but happened to leave on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Laisixing then lured Ayang to his death and proposed a campaign against Tianbao, but fell ill and had to withdraw before it could be launched.

sentences.zh: 復一令貴陽同知周鴻圖代為監軍，阿秧弟阿買與天保請兵邦彥，復兄仇。

translations.literal: Fuyi ordered Guiyang Subprefect Zhou Hongtu to replace him as military overseer; Ayang's younger brother Amai and Tianbao requested troops from Bangyan to avenge their elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyi appointed Guiyang subprefect Zhou Hongtu as the new military overseer; Ayang's younger brother Amai and Tianbao then asked Bangyan for troops to avenge Ayang's death.

sentences.zh: 復一以兵事屬鴻圖及欽，而遣參將胡從儀、楊明楷等佐之。

translations.literal: Fuyi entrusted military affairs to Hongtu and Qin, and dispatched Assistant Commanders Hu Congyi, Yang Mingkai, and others to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyi entrusted military operations to Hongtu and Qin, and sent assistant commanders Hu Congyi, Yang Mingkai, and others to support them.

sentences.zh: 欽等三道進，大戰米墩山，生擒天保及阿買，先後斬賊魁五十四人，獲首功二千三百五十，破焚百七十四寨。

translations.literal: Qin and the others advanced by three routes and fought a great battle at Midun Mountain; they captured Tianbao and Amai alive, beheaded fifty-four bandit chiefs in succession, claimed credit for twenty-three hundred fifty heads, and stormed and burned one hundred seventy-four stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and his forces advanced along three routes and fought a major battle at Midun Mountain, capturing Tianbao and Amai alive; they cut down fifty-four rebel chiefs in all, claimed credit for twenty-three hundred fifty heads, and destroyed one hundred seventy-four stockades by fire.

sentences.zh: 盛夏興師，將士冒暑雨，沖嵐瘴。

translations.literal: Campaigning in the height of summer, officers and soldiers endured heat and rain and braved mist and miasma.
translations.idiomatic: They had taken the field at the height of summer, and officers and men endured heat and rain while pushing through mist and malarial vapors.

sentences.zh: 劇寇盡除，土人謂二百年所未有。

translations.literal: The fierce bandits were entirely eliminated; the local people said such a thing had not occurred in two hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: The worst rebels were wiped out entirely; local people called it an achievement unseen in two hundred years.

sentences.zh: 復一既奏功，未報而卒。

translations.literal: Fuyi had already submitted a report on the achievement, but before a reply arrived he died.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyi had already submitted his victory report to the throne, but died before any response arrived.

sentences.zh: 監軍御史傅宗龍復以為言，乃命欽總理如故，鴻圖授平越知府。

translations.literal: Military overseer and censor Fu Zonglong again spoke on the matter; Qin was then ordered to continue as overall manager as before, and Hongtu was appointed prefect of Pingyue.
translations.idiomatic: Military overseer and censor Fu Zonglong raised the matter again; the court then restored Qin to his former post as overall manager and appointed Hongtu prefect of Pingyue.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，邦彥復大舉入寇。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year Bangyan again invaded on a large scale.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year Bangyan launched another major invasion.

sentences.zh: 欽禦之河上，連戰數日，殺傷相當。

translations.literal: Qin defended against him on the riverbank; they fought for several days in succession, with casualties roughly equal on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Qin held him on the riverbank; after several days of fighting casualties were roughly even on both sides.

sentences.zh: 夜半，賊直逼欽壘。

translations.literal: At midnight the bandits pressed straight up to Qin's camp.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight the rebels closed directly on Qin's camp.

sentences.zh: 將十逃竄，欽遂自刎。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers fled in disorder, and Qin then cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and men broke and ran, and Qin cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 諸營盡潰，賊勢復張。

translations.literal: All the camps collapsed completely, and the bandit power revived.
translations.idiomatic: Every camp collapsed, and the rebels' power surged anew.

sentences.zh: 欽勇敢善戰，為西南大將之冠。

translations.literal: Qin was brave and skilled in battle, the foremost general of the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Qin was brave and formidable in battle, the greatest general in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 莊烈帝嗣位，贈少保、左都督，世蔭指揮僉事，賜祭葬，建祠曰：「旌忠」。

translations.literal: When Emperor Sizong succeeded to the throne, Qin was posthumously granted Junior Guardian and Left Commissioner-in-chief; his heirs were granted hereditary rank as Battalion Commander; sacrificial honors and burial were granted; and a temple was built called "Commemorating Loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Sizong ascended the throne, Qin was posthumously invested as Junior Guardian and Left Commissioner-in-chief; his heirs received hereditary rank as battalion commander; he was granted state funeral rites; and a memorial shrine was erected under the name "Commemorating Loyalty."

sentences.zh: 子宗文承蔭。

translations.literal: His son Zongwen inherited the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongwen inherited the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，以薊鎮副總兵為總督吳阿衡中軍。

translations.literal: During the Chongzhen reign he served as deputy regional commander of the Ji garrison and as chief of staff to Governor Wu Aheng.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he served as deputy regional commander of the Ji garrison and as chief of staff to Governor Wu Aheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年冬，墻子嶺失事，與阿衡並力戰死。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eleventh year, at the disaster at Qiangzi Ridge, he fought to the death together with Aheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eleventh year, at the disaster at Qiangzi Ridge, he fought to the death alongside Aheng.

sentences.zh: 秦良玉，忠州人，嫁石砫宣撫使馬千乘。

translations.literal: Qin Liangyu was a native of Zhongzhou and married Ma Qianzheng, Pacification Commissioner of Shizhu.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Liangyu was a native of Zhongzhou and married Ma Qianzheng, the Pacification Commissioner of Shizhu.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十七年，千乘以三千人從征播州，良玉別統精卒五百裹糧自隨，與副將周國柱扼賊鄧坎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Wanli, Qianzheng followed the campaign against Bozhou with three thousand men; Liangyu separately commanded five hundred picked soldiers carrying their own rations, and together with Vice Commander Zhou Guozhu blocked the bandits at Dengkan.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli twenty-seven Qianzheng marched against Bozhou with three thousand men; Liangyu separately led five hundred picked troops carrying their own provisions and, with vice commander Zhou Guozhu, blocked the rebels at Dengkan.

sentences.zh: 明年正月二日，賊乘官軍宴，夜襲。

translations.literal: On the second day of the first month of the next year, the bandits took advantage of a banquet in the government army to launch a night attack.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the first month of the following year the rebels struck at night while the government troops were feasting.

sentences.zh: 良玉夫婦首擊敗之，追入賊境，連破金築等七寨。

translations.literal: The Liangyu couple were the first to defeat them, pursued into bandit territory, and in succession stormed seven stockades including Jinzhu.
translations.idiomatic: The Liangyus were first to repel the attack, pursued the enemy into rebel territory, and in succession overran seven stockades including Jinzhu.

sentences.zh: 已，偕酉陽諸軍直取桑木關，大敗賊眾，為南川路戰功第一。

translations.literal: Before long, together with the armies of Youyang they drove straight for Sangmu Pass, inflicted a great defeat on the bandit horde, and ranked first in merit on the Nanchuan route.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, joining forces with the Youyang armies, they drove straight for Sangmu Pass, routed the rebel force, and earned first place in merit on the Nanchuan route.

sentences.zh: 賊平，良玉不言功。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, Liangyu did not speak of her merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebellion was suppressed Liangyu made no claim to credit.

sentences.zh: 其後，千乘為部民所訟，瘐死雲陽獄，良玉代領其職。

translations.literal: Afterward Qianzheng was sued by his tribesmen, died of illness in Yunyang prison, and Liangyu took over his post in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qianzheng was impeached by his tribesmen, died of illness in Yunyang prison, and Liangyu succeeded to his office.

sentences.zh: 良玉為人饒膽智，善騎射，兼通詞翰，儀度嫻雅。

translations.literal: Liangyu was abundant in courage and wit, skilled in horsemanship and archery, and also versed in letters; her bearing was refined and elegant.
translations.idiomatic: Liangyu was bold and resourceful, skilled in horsemanship and archery, and also accomplished in letters; her bearing was refined and dignified.

sentences.zh: 而馭下嚴峻，每行軍發令，戎伍肅然。

translations.literal: Yet in commanding subordinates she was stern; whenever she marched and issued orders, the ranks were solemnly disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: Yet she ruled her troops with strict discipline; whenever she marched and gave orders, the ranks stood in silent order.

sentences.zh: 所部號白桿兵，為遠近所憚。

translations.literal: Her command was called the White Pole troops and was feared near and far.
translations.idiomatic: Her command was known as the White Pole troops and was feared far and wide.

sentences.zh: 部議再征兵二千。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated on raising another two thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved the levy of another two thousand troops.
